title: Sea Foam Green Shower Squeegee, 20-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass With Hook, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Sea Foam Green, shower squeegee, 20-Inch size, solid brass construction with smooth handle and wall mount decorative hook for bathroom use on shower doors, tile, and mirrors, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. Designed to remove moisture in quick strokes to reduce water spotting. Includes squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware; blade is replaceable. Traditional style bath accessory with designer lifetime finish options for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. No assembly required. Product dimensions: 10 x 15 x 10 in (LxHxW).
